notes.title: 【Game Update】Fixed a recall function issue for a specific question bank.
notes.content:
Hello, challengers of "LoveLove Quiz"!

This update addresses the following issues:
[olist]
[*] The recall function button for the '●' question bank not working ※1
[*] Numerous English typos and display issues with options.
[*] Some Chinese typos.
[/olist]

If you encounter any further issues, please don't hesitate to report them. Thank you very much for your support!

※1: The '●' is used to replace hidden content.

notes.title: ☆LoveLove Quiz☆ is now on sale!
notes.content:
The following is a reprint of a middle-aged man's words...

"I have experienced despair and loss. Before becoming unemployed, I was a game planner, working overtime and staying up late every day. Eventually, I fell seriously ill, and my body was covered in sores. With no other choice, I resigned to rest and recuperate. When I was in utter despair, an elder appeared before me...

Unfortunately, he did not invite me to participate in a love quiz, but instead, he pointed me in a direction! In the end, I tried to combine my years of experience, relying solely on my own strength, to produce a product and finally release it through a friend.

Although this is not a great work, it is a labor of love from a middle-aged man. No matter what you think, I hope you enjoy the game."

Alright! Let's thank this middle-aged man for his words. Although I don't understand why he had to say all this before the launch. ːsteamhappyː

[h2][b]【LoveLove Quiz】 is now on sale![/b]
The launch will be discounted for 14 days! We hope for your support![/h2]
